**Made in**: - [Tauri](https://tauri.app) - [Preact](https://preactjs.com)

title: HU Ruimte Reserveren
description:
A WRB (Web Resources Booking) system for HU University of Applied Sciences.
I worked on the backend, where I setup an ORM, many endpoints, and implemented OAuth with multi-service login.
I also developed a system that allows the global HU schedule to be scraped and imported in our system, providing us realistic testing data.
